steps.what: Retrieve and check the actual assigned reading and approved teaching case for this discussion
inputs: Existing assigned reading and approved teaching case

steps.what: Initiate, facilitate and moderate classroom discussions of social work practice, hear students' reasoning and address difficult contributions

tasks.design: Use the course-linked reading and case view in {LMS} to find existing discussion sources. The teacher leads the actual discussion, including ethical disagreement and sensitive disclosures.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assigned cases and readings may require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: The existing LMS can link the current session to its approved materials.
tasks.still_hard: Maintaining a respectful discussion while challenging weak or harmful reasoning.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher responds to actual students and the meaning of their contributions.

ambition.what: Reduce source retrieval effort without replacing discussion.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an LMS can link readings and approved teaching cases to course sessions.

assumptions: The teacher or course team already supplies the approved reading and teaching case; no client record, transcript or generated case is assumed.
This discussion task establishes no required written minutes, assessment entry or send; actual required records would need separate measured steps.
Course-material authoring is counted in task 6244 and not credited again here. Existing session links earn no additional gain.
Illustrative gross saving 2 per 100 task hours, upkeep 0.5, net 1.5; no unmeasured claim about shortening live discussion.
unknowns: Actual retrieval effort and whether current session links already exist
research_questions: Are the approved discussion sources already accessible from the session page?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured scenario with limited source-navigation effort; upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define the actual learning outcomes, social work topics, schedule and assignment requirements and select approved readings and teaching cases
outputs: Teacher-authored material brief and checked source set

steps.what: Assemble exact approved syllabus blocks, dates and reading metadata into the course material template
inputs: Checked brief and source set from s1
Existing approved reusable blocks and template
outputs: Assembled factual course-material skeleton and missing-field exceptions

steps.what: Draft course explanations, homework instructions and handout prose from the supplied learning outcomes and approved material
outputs: Draft syllabus, homework instructions or handout with source pointers

loop.purpose: Draft clear teaching prose aligned with the actual course brief
loop.input: Teacher brief, factual skeleton and approved readings and cases
loop.output: Draft prose with pointers to supplied sources
loop.check: Teacher checks every substantive statement, reading reference, assignment instruction and case detail in s4
loop.stop: Unsupported claim, missing source or identifiable client detail returns to teacher; no publication
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanatory prose requires semantic drafting; exact reusable content and metadata are assembled deterministically in s2

steps.what: Correct and check the complete materials for pedagogical fit, social work ethics, source accuracy, accessibility, dates and intended course recipients
inputs: Actual brief, sources and course group
outputs: Final checked course materials in their publication form

steps.what: Publish the final checked course materials to the intended course group in the LMS
inputs: Final checked course materials and recipients

tasks.design: Assemble approved reusable facts and blocks in {DOCS}, then use a bounded model to draft explanations from the teacher's checked material. The teacher checks the complete syllabus, homework or handout before a separate publication step in {LMS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated assembly of existing facts and first-draft prose can take time even when the teacher has defined the course.
tasks.enabler_now: Document templates can assemble exact content and a model can draft prose from a bounded source set.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing what students need to learn and designing meaningful social work assignments.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher judges educational value, ethical framing and suitability for the actual cohort.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated material assembly and drafting while retaining course design and full checks.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; course and data owners approve source use and publication access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document templates can assemble supplied facts, and language models can draft teaching prose for source-based human review.

assumptions: The teacher selects actual approved material and enters the brief in s1; the course team supplies reusable blocks. Missing dates or references remain exceptions, not inferred facts.
No actual client records are uploaded or converted into cases. Only already approved teaching material is supplied.
s2 replaces currently manual assembly; existing template autofill earns no new gain. The model does not invent readings or references.
Illustrative gross saving 30 per 100 task hours, upkeep 4, net 26; publication clicks earn no saving. Course source selection is counted once across related tasks.
unknowns: Existing template reuse and actual drafting versus course-design effort
research_questions: Which course facts and approved blocks are manually copied for each syllabus or assignment?

already_counted.description: Define and source the material, review draft prose and check the complete publication version

incremental.description: Maintain approved blocks, source mappings and draft-quality checks

approvals.approved_version: Complete course materials and group checked in s4; changes require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured scenario with manual factual assembly and prose drafting today; complete source checks retained and upkeep deducted.

tasks.short: Compile, administer and grade social work examinations

steps.what: Compile the examination from the actual approved item bank and criteria, adapting questions to the taught social work material
inputs: Actual approved item bank, taught material and assessment criteria
outputs: Compiled draft examination and closed-item key

steps.what: Check the complete examination, key, access arrangements and intended candidate group in its final assessment-system form
Release the final checked examination to the intended candidates
inputs: Final checked examination and candidate group

steps.what: Administer the actual examination and collect candidate-entered responses linked to the verified candidate roster
inputs: Actual candidates and existing verified roster
outputs: Actual digital examination responses with verified candidate identities

steps.what: Apply the exact checked key to captured closed-item examination responses
inputs: Actual digital closed responses from s4

steps.what: Grade each open response against the actual social work criteria, considering ethical reasoning and application to the supplied case
Check closed scores and exceptions against actual responses, combine results and check every final candidate grade and identifier
inputs: Closed score proposals and actual responses
outputs: Final checked grade export with candidate, course and assessment identifiers

steps.what: Map and stage the checked LMS grade export into the student registry's import preview without publishing results
inputs: Registry-owner-approved candidate, course, assessment and grade mappings
outputs: Staged registry import preview and unmatched-row exceptions

steps.what: Resolve import exceptions and check every final registry result and candidate against the checked source export and intended publication scope
inputs: Checked grade export and actual registry roster

steps.what: Commit and publish the final checked result batch in the student registry

tasks.design: Configure item-bank reuse and exact closed-item scoring in {LMS}, with a separate staged import into the student registry {OPS_SYSTEM}. The teacher retains open-answer grading, all source and identity checks and final publication; a model does not set grades.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual item assembly, fixed-key marking and re-entry of already checked grades can repeat work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing assessment tools can reuse items and mark exact keys, while a checked export-import mapping can replace registry retyping.
tasks.still_hard: Valid questions, ethical-reasoning assessment, examination exceptions and final grade responsibility.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher evaluates substantive social work reasoning and confirms each result.

ambition.what: Reduce mechanical examination assembly, marking and registry re-entry within examiner authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; assessment and registry owners approve mappings, examiner access and release controls

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: assessment systems can reuse approved items and apply exact keys, and checked grade exports can be mapped to a registry import.

assumptions: This scenario includes an existing digital examination and a required separate student-registry result entry. Candidate responses are entered by candidates during s4; the registry owner supplies actual identifier mappings, checked against the roster.
No paper-response transcription is free; paper examinations retain their capture labor. Missing identifiers or ambiguous grade mappings stop the affected import rows.
s5 replaces currently manual fixed-key marking and s8 replaces actual repeated registry entry; existing equivalent scoring or sync earns no new gain.
The teacher is the existing authorized examiner for this episode. No automated model grading, fraud decision or proctoring inference is proposed.
Illustrative gross saving 26 per 100 task hours, upkeep 4, net 22. Same-system publication clicks earn no gain; count this result transfer once across related grade-record tasks.
unknowns: Actual closed-question share, existing scoring and whether this institution already synchronizes results
research_questions: Which grades are actually re-entered between the assessment system and student registry, and can an import be previewed before release?

already_counted.description: Compile and check examination content, check final grades and verify the staged registry import

incremental.description: Maintain checked item keys, registry mappings and reconciliation checks

approvals.approved_version: Final examination, key and candidate group checked in s2; edits require rechecking
Final registry result batch and publication scope checked in s9; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured digital examination scenario with current manual fixed-key marking and registry re-entry; all final checks retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.short: Supervise students' laboratory and field work

steps.what: Retrieve and check the student's current field-learning agreement, supervision requirements and approved assessment criteria
inputs: Existing student learning agreement and supervision requirements

steps.what: Supervise the student's actual laboratory or field work, discuss practice and intervene when professional boundaries or safety require it
outputs: Observed performance and actual supervision feedback

steps.what: Write and check the required supervision record using student-linked fields and actual observed performance and feedback
inputs: Actual observations and feedback from s2

steps.what: Save the final supervision record in the same student-learning system

tasks.design: Configure the current learning-agreement view and student-linked supervision form in {LMS}. The teacher supervises actual practice and writes and checks the required record from actual observations before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Learning requirements and supervision forms can require repeated student lookup and identity entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing course and student-linked views can reduce those repeated operations.
tasks.still_hard: Judging professional practice, confidentiality, client welfare and student development.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher observes actual work and exercises professional judgment in context.

ambition.what: Reduce lookup and required recording effort while keeping supervision human.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; placement and course owners check student-record access and client-information boundaries

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: learning systems can link supervision requirements and record forms to a student identifier.

assumptions: The institution already requires a supervision record for this episode; no extra report is added to every informal interaction.
The course team supplies existing learning agreements; s1 checks currency and s3 manually captures actual observations. No client database or free transcript is assumed.
No placement-provider message, client intervention or grade release is automated. Actual required sends require their own final checks and send steps.
Illustrative gross saving 3.4 per 100 task hours, upkeep 1, net 2.4; no saving from the same-system save or actual supervision.
unknowns: Actual learning-system capabilities and required supervision documentation
research_questions: Does the current supervision form already inherit student and placement identity?

already_counted.description: Check learning requirements and capture and check actual supervision observations

incremental.description: Maintain learning-agreement links and supervision fields

approvals.approved_version: Final supervision record checked in s3; changes require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured supervision episode with existing required recording; only lookup and repeated identity entry reduced after upkeep.
